mainEntity.name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of PAA content?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure the success of PAA content, key metrics include organic search visibility, specifically tracking impressions and clicks from PAA features. Monitor keyword rankings for questions targeted, looking for improvements in top positions. Website traffic, particularly new users originating from search, indicates increased reach. Engagement metrics like bounce rate and time on page for PAA-optimized content can show user satisfaction. Ultimately, tracking conversion rates from PAA-driven traffic demonstrates business impact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track organic impressions and clicks from PAA features, keyword rankings for targeted questions, website traffic, engagement metrics, and conversion rates to measure PAA content success.
